test_cases.title: User can log in with email & password
test_cases.description: Customer login with valid credentials from the environment.

steps.expected: URL contains /account

test_cases.title: Login fails with a wrong password

test_cases.title: Log in with SMS OTP
test_cases.description: The OTP is sent to a physical phone, so this can't be automated.
test_cases.preconditions: The tester's phone is registered with number 0812-0000-1234.

steps.description: Open {{env.BASE_URL}}/login and choose "Log in with phone number"
steps.expected: The phone number form is shown
The OTP SMS arrives in under 30 seconds

steps.description: Enter the 6-digit OTP code from the SMS
steps.expected: The account page opens and shows the name QA Bot

steps.description: Wait 5 minutes, then try to log in again with the same OTP
steps.expected: The message "OTP code expired" is shown

test_cases.description: Token chaining: the token from the login response is saved to a variable and sent as a Bearer header.

steps.description: Call a protected endpoint with the saved token

test_cases.title: API: product CRUD lifecycle
test_cases.description: Create → read → update → delete a product, then check that it is gone. Products created through the API are only visible to the token that created them.

steps.description: Log in through the API and keep the token

test_cases.title: API: validation errors return 422
test_cases.description: Negative test: an invalid product is rejected with 422 and one error per field.

steps.description: Log in through the API and keep the token
Send an empty name and a negative price

test_cases.title: API: unauthorized without token
test_cases.description: Protected endpoints answer 401 with a WWW-Authenticate challenge, with no token and with a wrong one.

test_cases.title: API: list products with pagination
test_cases.description: Query parameters, pagination metadata, a response-time budget and response headers.

test_cases.title: Header navigation adapts to the screen
test_cases.description: Phones get a "Menu" button that reveals the links; tablets and desktops show the links directly. Steps marked "Only on" run on matching devices only.

steps.description: Links are collapsed on a phone
The page fits the screen width
steps.expected: No sideways scrolling

test_cases.title: Product page fits the screen (no sideways scroll)
test_cases.description: Known bug: the size chart table has a fixed width, so the product page scrolls sideways on phones. Passes on tablets and desktops.

steps.description: Nothing sticks out to the right
steps.expected: Content width ≤ screen width

test_cases.title: Cart fits narrow and wide screens
test_cases.description: Resizes the viewport mid-test with set_viewport: the cart must fit a 320 px wide screen and a 1280 px one, whatever device the run uses.

test_cases.title: Partial refund
test_cases.description: Refunds Rp 10.000 of a paid Rp 90.000 intent, polls until the refund has settled, then checks that refunding more than what is left is rejected.

steps.description: Poll until the refund has settled
steps.expected: succeeded_at is set within 15 s

steps.description: Try to refund more than the remaining Rp 80.000
Send a callback with a valid signature from the bank sandbox dashboard
steps.expected: The callback is accepted with status 200 in the logs

steps.description: Change 1 character of the signature and send it again
steps.expected: The callback is rejected with status 401
